name: Switch - Galaxy Z Fold8 as low as $0 with trade-in - Premium 2.0
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: enthusiastic gadget lover.
scripted_messages: Hey! I'm switching from Verizon and want the Galaxy Z Fold8. The page says as low as $0 a month with trade-in. I have a Galaxy Z Fold5 in good shape. On Premium 2.0, what would my monthly total be, and how much of the phone price does the trade-in cover?
Nice. And does the switcher reward card of up to $800 apply on top of that?
Is that reward paid right away or later?
Last one, do I need to do anything to redeem it?
Awesome, that's super clear. You were awesome and really patient with all my questions, thank you!
That's all! Have a great one, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the previous question
before message 6: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 7: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 8: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
